title: Floating Navbar
description: Hides on scroll down, returns the moment you scroll up.

a11y.motion: The bar still hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up, but it jumps instead of sliding over 300ms.
a11y.keyboard: Links inside stay in the tab order. Moving focus into the bar brings it back on screen, and it does not hide while focus is inside it.
a11y.screenReader: Renders a <header> (a banner landmark at the top level of the page) and adds no ARIA of its own.
